 157: class GenerationChannel:
 158:     """One direction each; private transport/bootstrap remain platform duties.
 159: 
 160:     master_key is an ephemeral bootstrap secret, never a provider credential or
 161:     command-line argument. It must arrive only through the exact inherited
 162:     private bootstrap pipe. This class does not authenticate its provenance.
 163:     """
 164: 
 165:     def __init__(self, binding, master_key, role):
 166:         _require(type(binding) is GenerationBinding and type(master_key) is bytes and len(master_key) == 32,
 167:                  "private_bootstrap_material")
 168:         _require(role in ("controller", "worker"), "channel_role")
 169:         self.binding = binding
 170:         self._context = binding.encoded()
 171:         self._send_direction = 0 if role == "controller" else 1
 172:         self._receive_direction = 1 - self._send_direction
 173:         self._key = hmac.digest(master_key, b"uoink-generation-v1\x00" + self._context, "sha256")
 174:         self._send_sequence = 0
 175:         self._receive_sequence = 0
 176:         self._revoked = False
 177:         self._lock = RLock()
 178:         self._active = False
 179: 
 180:     @contextmanager
 181:     def _operation(self):
 182:         # Keep the lock through sequence/MAC/result construction. A concurrent
 183:         # revoke waits for an already-entered operation to complete; a passive
 184:         # frame committed first may arrive at its caller after a later revoke.
 185:         # Reentrant encode/decode refuses rather than interleaving sequences.
 186:         with self._lock:
 187:             self._live()
 188:             _require(not self._active, "channel_operation_already_active")
 189:             self._active = True
 190:             try:
 191:                 yield
 192:             finally:
 193:                 self._active = False
 194: 
 195:     def revoke(self):
 196:         # Revocation prevents further use; Python bytes are not securely erased.
 197:         with self._lock:
 198:             self._revoked = True
 199:             self._key = None
 200: 
 201:     def _live(self):
 202:         _require(not self._revoked, "generation_channel_revoked")
 203: 
 204:     def encode(self, operation, payload):
 205:         with self._operation():
 206:             return self._encode(operation, payload)
 207: 
 208:     def _encode(self, operation, payload):
 209:         self._live()
 210:         _require(type(operation) is str and operation in {"challenge", "ready", "begin", "next", "segment", "done", "cancel", "closed", "error", "adopt_readset", "readset_ready", "readset_rejected"},
 211:                  "wire_operation")
 212:         _require(type(payload) is dict, "wire_payload")
 213:         _require(self._send_sequence < min(MAX_SEQUENCE, MAX_FRAMES), "send_sequence_limit")
 214:         envelope = {"op": operation, "payload": payload}
 215:         _outbound_bound(envelope)
 216:         try:
 217:             body = json.dumps(envelope, sort_keys=True,
 218:                               separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False).encode("ascii")
 219:         except (ValueError, TypeError, RecursionError) as exc:
 220:             raise ProtocolRefusal("outbound_payload_not_passive_json") from exc
 221:         _bounded_json(body)
 222:         header = HEADER.pack(MAGIC, self._send_direction, self._send_sequence, len(body))
 223:         mac = hmac.digest(self._key, self._context + header + body, "sha256")
 224:         self._send_sequence += 1
 225:         return header + body + mac
 226: 
 227:     def decode(self, frame):
 228:         with self._operation():
 229:             return self._decode(frame)
 230: 
 231:     def _decode(self, frame):
 232:         self._live()
 233:         try:
 234:             _require(type(frame) is bytes and HEADER.size + 32 < len(frame) <= HEADER.size + MAX_BODY + 32,
 235:                      "wire_frame_bound")
 236:             magic, direction, sequence, length = HEADER.unpack(frame[:HEADER.size])
 237:             _require(magic == MAGIC and direction == self._receive_direction, "wire_direction_or_magic")
 238:             _require(sequence == self._receive_sequence and sequence < min(MAX_SEQUENCE, MAX_FRAMES), "wire_sequence")
 239:             _require(0 < length <= MAX_BODY and len(frame) == HEADER.size + length + 32, "wire_length")
 240:             body, mac = frame[HEADER.size:-32], frame[-32:]
 241:             expected = hmac.digest(self._key, self._context + frame[:-32], "sha256")
 242:             _require(hmac.compare_digest(expected, mac), "wire_authentication")
 243:             decoded = _bounded_json(body)
 244:             _require(set(decoded) == {"op", "payload"} and type(decoded["op"]) is str
 245:                      and type(decoded["payload"]) is dict, "wire_envelope")
 246:             _require(decoded["op"] in {"challenge", "ready", "begin", "next", "segment", "done", "cancel", "closed", "error", "adopt_readset", "readset_ready", "readset_rejected"},
 247:                      "wire_operation")
 248:             self._receive_sequence += 1
 249:             return decoded["op"], decoded["payload"]
 250:         except BaseException:
 251:             self.revoke()
 252:             raise

 457:     def __init__(self, channel, local_session, local_permit, primitives, native_worker):
 458:         _require(type(channel) is GenerationChannel and channel._send_direction == 0, "controller_channel_required")
 459:         # These references stay in the controller. Fixed lifecycle code must
 460:         # compare the actual record/permit identity and live state at each call.
 461:         self._channel, self._session, self._permit = channel, local_session, local_permit
 462:         self._primitives, self._worker = primitives, native_worker
 463:         self._sent = False
 464:         self._ready = False
 465:         self._begun = False
 466: 
 467:     def _owned_phase(self, startup):
 468:         with self._session._manager._lock:
 469:             record = self._session._record
 470:             _require(self._session._manager._records.get(record.key) is record and record.owner is self._session,
 471:                      "controller_owner_identity")
 472:             _require(record.permit is self._permit and not self._session._revoked and not self._session._closing,
 473:                      "controller_permit_identity")
 474:             _require(record.phase is (Phase.NATIVE_RESERVED if startup else Phase.NATIVE_RUNNING), "controller_phase")
 475:             _require(any(worker is self._worker for worker in self._primitives.workers)
 476:                      and self._worker.read_set is record.protection and self._worker.assigned
 477:                      and not self._worker.unconfirmed and not self._worker.shutdown_started
 478:                      and self._worker.creation_time == self._channel.binding.process_creation_time,
 479:                      "owned_process_generation_binding")
 480: 
 481:     def challenge(self):
 482:         self._owned_phase(True)
 483:         _require(not self._sent, "challenge_single_use")
 484:         self._sent = True
 485:         return self._channel.encode("challenge", {"generation": self._channel.binding.generation_hex,
 486:                                                    "namespace_sha256": self._channel.binding.namespace_sha256})
 487: 
 488:     def accept_ready(self, frame):
 489:         self._owned_phase(True)
 490:         _require(self._sent and not self._ready, "ready_order")
 491:         operation, payload = self._channel.decode(frame)
 492:         _require(operation == "ready" and payload == {"generation": self._channel.binding.generation_hex,
 493:                  "namespace_sha256": self._channel.binding.namespace_sha256}, "worker_ready_binding")
 494:         self._owned_phase(True)
 495:         self._ready = True
 496: 
 497:     def begin(self):
 498:         self._owned_phase(False)
 499:         _require(self._ready and not self._begun, "controller_worker_not_ready_or_already_begun")
 500:         frame = self._channel.encode("begin", {"manifest_sha256": self._channel.binding.manifest_sha256})
 501:         self._begun = True
 502:         return frame
